Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Robotics is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to work on Fleet OS, the service that routes hundreds of autonomous robots through customer warehouses.

What you'll do:
- Own services that ingest and act on high-volume robot telemetry
- Design APIs used by our on-robot navigation stack and by customer WMS integrations
- Take part in on-call and lead blameless incident reviews
- Mentor two or three mid-level engineers on the platform team

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production backend services in Go or TypeScript
- Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including query tuning and schema migration
- You have designed and operated event-driven systems (we use Kafka)
- Experience running services on Kubernetes
- Excellent written communication; we are a documentation-first team

Nice to have:
- Exposure to robotics, IoT or other real-time telemetry domains
- Experience with Terraform
- Bonus points for prior work in logistics or warehousing
